title: Long requests through Cloudflare fail with Error 524 after about two minutes
symptoms: Exports or report endpoints fail only when proxied
Older answers cite 100 seconds while the cutoff is now 125 seconds
cause: Cloudflare waits 125 seconds for the origin to send response headers before returning 524. Only Enterprise zones can raise this proxy read timeout.
fix: Return quickly and finish the work in the background with a job id the client polls, or serve the long endpoint from a DNS only hostname.
affected: Cloudflare proxied zones on Free, Pro, and Business; Enterprise can raise the timeout up to 6,000 s
